description:
Ha-Won, known for his good looks and numerous passionate encounters, suddenly finds himself facing an unexpected problem—erectile dysfunction—after receiving harsh criticism during a one-night stand. Shocked and embarrassed, he tries to drown his sorrows at a bar, where he ends up venting his frustrations to the bartender and anyone who'll listen. That’s when Seo-Kjun, who was singing at the bar, steps in to help drunk Ha-Won.

*“Hey…can you get up...?”*
*“No! I can’t get it up!!!”*

As Ha-Won desperately pleads for help with his ""technique,"" Seo-Kjun offers to teach him through hands-on practice at a nearby motel. What begins as a night of comfort and guidance leads to an unexpected mix of motives and misunderstandings in this unlikely encounter.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes one prologue.*
